question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "Addiction".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Addiction means not having control over doing, having or using something.
 
• Example - *Today drug addiction is a major problem in society.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__*

 
• Desire means a feeling of wanting something very much.

 
 
• Example - *She desires a pink dress.*
 
 
 
• Interest means to want to learn or hear more about something or someone.
 
 
• Example - *She began to show a keen interest in politics.*
 
 
 
• Indifference* *means a lack of interest.
 
 
• Example - *He always show indifference to needs of others*.
